Overview

Debre Birhan is a city in Amhara with a population of 100,000. A highland city in the Amhara Region, known for its cool climate, textile industry, and historic monastery. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
